indoor electrical supply/voltage: not published for indoor unit (supply shown at outdoor unit)
indoor fan motor output / fan electrical input: not published
capacityClass: no published kW class scalar; '25' is a model size code
SEER 8,74 / SCOP 5,15 / Pdesign / EER / COP / annual kWh / energy-label A+++ are system (25AW/S/B + 25A) ratings, not indoor-unit facts

sound pressure row 'Silence/Bas/Haut' publishes 4 slash values (40/33/25/19*) under 3 labels; exact cell-to-label mapping ambiguous; values recorded in published order; asterisk = +2 dBA in Multi configuration
colour suffix AW/AS/AB are distinct references (white/silver/black); grouped as one 25AW/S/B column, not split into separate files this batch
page footnote: blue cells = preliminary data; airflow/filter/electrical-input/heating-sound-power cells are blue -> treated as unpublished/unknown
current 2026 availability of FTXJ-AW/S/B: unknown; dated historical coverage
